title: Iron Haze deployment diagram
description: How Iron Haze runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no storage, on the route icelander.net/games/fresh/iron-haze*. The browser runs the Godot WebAssembly export; the desktop builds run on the player's computer. The engine's .wasm and the desktop zips are larger than Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit for a static file, so build.mjs stores them in 20 MiB parts and the Worker streams the parts back as one file.
